name: @crm/appointments-service
description: Owns appointment lifecycle (appointments_schema: appointments, appointment_status_history, local projections fed by company.*/company-member.*/service.*/specialist-service.*/review.* events, appointment_recommendation_projections (moved from backend-projection-service in Phase 12), processed_events, outbox_events). Serves POST/GET /companies/:companyId/appointments, PATCH .../appointments/:appointmentId, POST .../complete, GET /appointments/me, GET /appointments/:appointmentId/status-history, POST /appointments/:appointmentId/cancel. See docs/architecture/microservices-extraction-checklist.md Phase 9 and Phase 12.
